descriptionfr: dDans ce projet, je transmets les apprentissages issus de mes lectures des livres Design Patterns et Game Coding Complete à travers la réalisation d’un roguelike auto-battler. J’utilise différents modèles de conception, tels que le Strategy Pattern et le State Pattern, afin de créer un système robuste et modulaire, essentiel à ce type de jeu.
descriptioneng: In this project, I apply the knowledge gained from my readings of the books Design Patterns and Game Coding Complete through the development of a roguelike auto-battler. I use various design patterns, such as the Strategy Pattern and the State Pattern, to build a robust and modular system, which is essential for this type of game.
